title: Alduin's Bane
description: After acquiring the Elder Scroll, the Dragonborn must read it at the Time-Wound on the Throat of the World to witness the ancient Nords using Dragonrend against Alduin, learn the shout, and then use it to defeat Alduin in the present.

base_facts: I have waited long at the Throat of the World for one who is doom-driven.
The Elder Scroll â€” the Kel â€” will allow you to see through the Time-Wound and learn Dragonrend.
Alduin will come when he senses the Elder Scroll. You must be ready.

READ_ELDER_SCROLL: The Dovahkiin has the Kel and stands at the Time-Wound. The vision will now unfold.
LEARN_DRAGONREND: The Dovahkiin has learned Dragonrend from the ancient Nord heroes. Now it must be used against Alduin.
DEFEAT_ALDUIN: Alduin has been forced to flee, but he is not truly slain. He will retreat to Sovngarde to feast on souls.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Alduin has been forced to flee the Throat of the World, but he is not truly slain; he has retreated to Sovngarde to feast on the souls of the dead.
The Dovahkiin has proven strong enough to wound Alduin with Dragonrend, but the World-Eater's threat persists beyond Mundus.
The Kel (Elder Scroll) remains with the Dovahkiin, still bound to their destiny and unable to be discarded.

base_facts: I am Alduin, Firstborn of Akatosh and World-Eater.
No mortal can truly slay me on Mundus.

DEFEAT_ALDUIN: I have been wounded by Dragonrend but I cannot be slain here. I will outlast the mortals and feast in Sovngarde.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I cannot be slain here on Mundus by any mortal, not even the Dovahkiin.
I will outlast the mortals and retreat to Sovngarde, where I will continue to grow in power by feasting on the souls of the dead.
The Dovahkiin has become strong, but I am Al-du-in, Firstborn of Akatosh, and my lordship will be restored.

beats.comment: Player reads the Elder Scroll at the Time-Wound and enters the vision of the past.
During the vision, the ancient Nord heroes use Dragonrend against Alduin and the player learns the shout.
Player uses Dragonrend to ground Alduin and defeats him in combat at the Throat of the World. Alduin flees to Sovngarde.
Alduin is driven off and the quest is complete. He cannot be slain here and retreats to Sovngarde.
